description: This Java source file defines the NetConverters class and several nested converter classes for converting between network-related Java objects such as String, InetAddress, URI, and URL. These converters facilitate transformations and error handling among these types in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: NetConverters
classes.description: Main class providing mechanisms to load converters between various network-related types.

classes.name: StringToInetAddress
classes.description: Converts String to InetAddress, resolving hostnames.

classes.name: InetAddressToString
classes.description: Converts InetAddress to its hostname or IP address as String.

classes.name: StringToURI
classes.description: Converts String to URI, parsing the string as a URI.

classes.name: URIToString
classes.description: Converts URI to String via its toString() method.

classes.name: StringToURL
classes.description: Converts String to URL by first parsing as URI then converting to URL.

classes.name: URLToString
classes.description: Converts URL to String via its toString() method.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the conversion between source and target types, implementing error handling and throwing ConversionException.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters into the system.
